caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular chest with a slightly domed lid, covered in a faded fabric that appears to be beige with patches of red and possibly green patterns. The chest is reinforced with metal straps and numerous metal studs along the edges and across the surface. There is a large metal lock plate on the front center, and two metal handles attached to either side of the chest. The fabric shows visible wear and damage, with frayed and peeling sections exposing the underlying surface. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simpler outline sketch of the same chest, showing its basic form and features without color or textures. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned.
title: Deerskin Covered Chest
